question: The graph below gives information about the percentage of the population in four Asian countries living in cities from 1970 to 2020, with predictions for 2030 and 2040.
essay: The graph illustrates the proportion of urban population in four Asian nations between 1970 and 2020, with future projections up to 2040. Overall, all four countries display an upward trend in urbanization throughout the period. In 1970, Philippines had the highest rate around 32%, but Malaysia grew rapidly to exceed 80% by 2040.
sourceMaterial: Line graph showing urban population percentages from 1970 to 2040 in 4 Asian countries.
